1: // Simple endless runner for canvas with id "game"
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
5: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 200;
6: 
7: // Game config
8: const GRAVITY = 0.5;
9: const JUMP_STRENGTH = -10;
10: const SPEED = 2;
11: const OBSTACLE_FREQ = 120; // frames
12: const TOKEN_FREQ = 300;
13: let frame = 0;
14: let score = 0;
15: let speed = SPEED;
16: 
17: // Player
18: const player = {x:50, y:canvas.height-30, w:30, h:30, vy:0, onGround:true};
19: 
20: // Entities
21: const obstacles = [];
22: const tokens = [];
23: 
24: function spawnObstacle(){
25:   const h = 30 + Math.random()*30;
26:   obstacles.push({x:canvas.width, y:canvas.height-h, w:20, h});
27: }
28: function spawnToken(){
29:   const size = 15;
30:   tokens.push({x:canvas.width, y:canvas.height-60, w:size, h:size, collected:false});
31: }
32: 
33: function update(){
34:   frame++;
35:   // Player physics
36:   player.vy += GRAVITY;
37:   player.y += player.vy;
38:   if(player.y + player.h >= canvas.height){
39:     player.y = canvas.height - player.h;
40:     player.vy = 0;
41:     player.onGround = true;
42:   }
43: 
44:   // Move obstacles and tokens
45:   obstacles.forEach(o=> o.x -= speed);
46:   tokens.forEach(t=> t.x -= speed);
47: 
48:   // Remove off‑screen
49:   while(obstacles.length && obstacles[0].x + obstacles[0].w < 0) obstacles.shift();
50:   while(tokens.length && tokens[0].x + tokens[0].w < 0) tokens.shift();
51: 
52:   // Spawn
53:   if(frame % OBSTACLE_FREQ === 0) spawnObstacle();
54:   if(frame % TOKEN_FREQ === 0) spawnToken();
55: 
56:   // Collision detection
57:   for(const o of obstacles){
58:     if(player.x < o.x + o.w && player.x + player.w > o.x &&
59:        player.y < o.y + o.h && player.y + player.h > o.y){
60:       // Game over
61:       alert('Game Over! Score: ' + Math.round(score));
62:       document.location.reload();
63:     }
64:   }
65:   for(const t of tokens){
66:     if(!t.collected && player.x < t.x + t.w && player.x + player.w > t.x &&
67:         player.y < t.y + t.h && player.y + player.h > t.y){
68:       t.collected = true;
69:       speed += 0.3; // speed boost
70:     }
71:   }
72: 
73:   // Score
74:   score += speed * 0.1;
75: }
76: 
77: function draw(){
78:   ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
79:   // Player
80:   ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
81:   ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
82:   // Obstacles
83:   ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
84:   obstacles.forEach(o=> ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h));
85:   // Tokens
86:   ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
87:   tokens.forEach(t=> { if(!t.collected) ctx.fillRect(t.x, t.y, t.w, t.h); });
88:   // Score
89:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
90:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
91:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.round(score), 10, 20);
92: }
93: 
94: function loop(){
95:   update();
96:   draw();
97:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
98: }
99: 
100: // Input
101: window.addEventListener('keydown', e=>{ if(e.code === 'Space' && player.onGround){ player.vy = JUMP_STRENGTH; player.onGround = false; } });
102: canvas.addEventListener('click',()=>{ if(player.onGround){ player.vy = JUMP_STRENGTH; player.onGround = false; } });
103: 
104: loop();
